competencies.name: Acting
competencies.description: Performing characters through voice, movement, and emotional expression

competencies.name: Stage Acting
competencies.description: Performing live theater for audiences in theatrical venues

prerequisites.notes: Basic acting skills are helpful for stage work

competencies.name: Voice Acting
competencies.description: Performing character voices for animation, games, and audio productions

competencies.name: Improvisation
competencies.description: Creating spontaneous performances without scripts or preparation

competencies.name: Method Acting
competencies.description: Technique drawing on personal emotions and experiences to create authentic performances

prerequisites.notes: Acting fundamentals are helpful for method acting

competencies.name: Musical Theater
competencies.description: Performing in productions combining acting, singing, and dance

prerequisites.notes: Acting skills are important for musical theater

competencies.name: Stage Combat
competencies.description: Choreographed fighting techniques for safe theatrical violence

competencies.name: Mime
competencies.description: Silent performance art using gesture, movement, and facial expression

competencies.name: Puppetry
competencies.description: Performing with puppets and manipulating characters through inanimate objects

competencies.name: Stand-up Comedy
competencies.description: Solo comedic performance delivering jokes and stories to live audiences

competencies.name: Directing
competencies.description: Guiding actors and creative teams to realize theatrical productions

competencies.name: Stage Management
competencies.description: Coordinating all technical and organizational aspects of theatrical productions

competencies.name: Set Design
competencies.description: Designing physical environments and scenery for theatrical productions

competencies.name: Costume Design
competencies.description: Creating clothing and accessories for theatrical characters

competencies.name: Lighting Design
competencies.description: Planning and implementing lighting for theatrical productions

competencies.name: Sound Design
competencies.description: Creating audio environments and effects for theatrical productions

competencies.name: Props Making
competencies.description: Creating and managing stage properties for theatrical productions

competencies.name: Stage Makeup
competencies.description: Applying theatrical makeup for performances under stage lighting

competencies.name: Audition Technique
competencies.description: Skills for preparing and performing successful theatrical auditions

competencies.name: Monologue Performance
competencies.description: Performing solo dramatic speeches showcasing acting abilities

prerequisites.notes: Acting skills are important for monologue work
